 Follow Pregnant ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ star Jen Affleck shockingly files for divorce from husband Zac
 Antoinette Bueno, Bernie Zilio Updated Thu, November 5, 2026 at 12:05 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" star Jen Affleck has filed for divorce from her husband, Zac Affleck, after more than seven years of marriage.
 Page Six can confirm that Jen — who is currently pregnant with her and Zac's fourth child — submitted her petition Tuesday in Utah County District Court.
 In Utah, many of the documents filed within a divorce case are classified as private, but we can confirm the reality personality attached a proposed parenting plan as well.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement TMZ was first to report the news.
 Jen Affleck has filed for divorce from husband Zac Affleck. (The two are pictured together in an Instagram selfie.) jenniferlaffleck/Instagram
 Jen and Zac (pictured here) have been married for over seven years, tying the knot in 2019. @jenniferlaffleck/Instagram
 Jen, 27, and Zac, 30, met on the Mormon dating app Mutual in 2018 and got married in 2019. They share three children together — Nora, 4, Lucas, 3, and Penelope, 1 — with another on the way.
 The "Dancing With the Stars" alum announced her fourth pregnancy in June on Instagram , sharing photos of her showing off her baby bump. Her husband did not appear in the pictures.
 Jen and Zac have been open about their marriage struggles on "SLOMW" since Season 1. Jen shared that the two went to therapy to resolve their issues, and that their relationship was strengthened.
 Still, the tension continued during Season 5, when Zac was not supportive of Jen's ambitions, including her wanting to appear on "Sports Illustrated."
 Jen is currently pregnant with their fourth child together. (The "Dancing With the Stars" alum and Zac are pictured above in a social media upload.) @jenniferlaffleck/Instagram
 Jen (pictured above during a Decider interview) and Zac already share Nora, 4, Lucas, 3, and Penelope, 1. Brian Zak/NY Post
 Advertisement Advertisement "Zac was taught growing up to not only be modest himself but for it to be an expectation for women around him," she said in a confessional, adding that it's "definitely been hard navigating [her] career goals" while also honoring Zac's "traditional values and traditional views."
 "I feel like if he truly loved me unconditionally, he would want to support me and I don't even feel like there's a conversation of a compromise," she continued.
 She also shared that he threatened to divorce her if she got an acting gig and played a character in a relationship with someone else.
 Jen (pictured above in a selfie) has been open about how she feels Zac doesn't support her career goals, including appearing on "Sports Illustrated" and acting. jenniferlaffleck/Instagram
 Jen (seen here) is starring in the "SLOMW" spinoff, "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County," which premieres Nov. 12 on Hulu. jenniferlaffleck/Instagram
 "I feel like Zac is not taking these dreams and goals seriously," she noted. "I think he's afraid of losing me."
 Advertisement Advertisement Jen is set to star in the Hulu reality series' upcoming spinoff, "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County," following the family's move from Utah to Southern California.
 The show premieres Nov. 12.
